items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...according to the discography by Ashland... [INTERVIEWEE] Could be, yes. Could be.

ctx.x: Well, it was the week after Easter, I remember that, in 1932.
Oh, and -- well, according to the discography by Ashland, "Shiek of Araby" was recorded in May -- May 16, 1932.
